page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top left, page number at top right. No marginal notes. Three small stray marks in the left margin, not text.

main_text.l: simulationem falsiloquorum, cauterio nota-
tam habentium conscientiam, prohibentium
contrahere matrimonium, 1. Tim. 4. abhor-
rentium à coniugio, & tàquam rem propha-
nam damnantium: quales fuerūt Encratitæ,
de quibus Eusebius lib.4.Eccles.hist.cap.28.
& Irenæus de Continentibus cap.30. lib.1.
Tatiani, Cathari cum sua secta, Manichæi,
Hierax, nec non Syricius Papa, qui dicit, con-
iugium esse in carne viuere, & Deo placere
non posse: Dist.82.[?] Can.2.
2 Quoniam autem omnes capiunt Chri-
sti esse & post eum venire, in quocunque tan-
dem statu sint: operæ precium est, indicare
modum, quo id effici queat. Multi enim hoc
volunt, seu potius velle dicunt, sed interim
viam quæ huc ducit non curant, neque am-
bulare volunt: cùm tamen nullus ordo sit
vel fuerit in Papatu, siue Augustinianorum,
siue Franciscanorum, siue aliorum, qui non
cognouerit & diligenter seruauerit sui Ordi-
nis regulam. Itaque & nos Christiani serue-
mus nostram: de qua hoc loco ipse Christus:
Etenim si quis, inquit, vult meus esse, abne-
gato seipso, & cruce sublata, me sequatur, vel
ad exemplum meum se conformet.
Ergo Christi discipulus censeri debet, qui
verus eius imitator exiftit, ac in eodem cur-
rere stadio paratus est. Nam discipulorum
est, ut præceptores suos sequantur.
3 Breuem autem imitationis regulam
præscribit, ut sciamus qua præcipuè in re v[?]

page.notes: Running head printed with spaced capitals "N V P T I A L E S." and read as NUPTIALES. Printed "Dist.82" is doubtful: the last digit is unclear, so it is marked [?]. Printed line end "seruemus" shows no hyphen, so it is written whole. Last line of the page breaks off mid-word ("re v"); the fragment is kept as it stands. Three small stray marks in the left margin (beside "vel fuerit", "currere", and at the foot) are not text and are not transcribed. The "§ 3" at the foot is taken as a signature mark.
